summary: Iteration 3 validated the new Forward-Test money-model with three modes (balanced / highwinrate / nosl) + annual (D1/365) period + trade dates + reality-check UI. All 12 pytest cases pass. Frontend replay, mode toggles, period presets, reality-check tiles, honesty notes, trades table with dates and APERTO badge all render correctly on real Tickmill data. The nosl trap is exposed truthfully: closed-trade winrate 100% but Equity Reale drops below start when an open trade drags floating negative (observed Equity Reale €9754.18 with Flottante -€445.85 on the Anno run).
action_items: OBSERVATION (not a bug): On the 500-bar EUR/USD M15 real-data window, balanced mode currently produces winrate ~29% and negative expectancy (-€26.19/trade). Review request said 'aims for 40-55%'. Not a hard failure — real-market SMC entry rules simply weren't profitable on this slice. Consider looser tolerance or a longer warmup window if the 'balanced' label is meant to imply profitability.

OBSERVATION (not a bug): The 'Anno' preset uses bars=365 on D1, which after weekend stripping actually spans ~17 calendar months (2025-04-27 → 2026-09-21) instead of a strict 12 months. If exact 1Y is desired, use bars=~252 (trading days).

OBSERVATION: The single 'symbol switch resets panel' regression check couldn't run — my selector `[data-testid^=watchlist-]` matched only 1 element (likely the container). Reset logic is a simple useEffect on symbol prop; not risky. Main agent can add per-item data-testids like `watchlist-item-EURUSD` if we want this covered by automation.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 778 lines (still above the 700-line threshold from iter2). Recommend splitting into routers.
run_forward_test still recomputes smart_money_zones every bar in balanced mode — O(n * warmup) — for D1/365 acceptable, but crosses O(15k) swing scans per run.
The default `mode` for ForwardTestReq is 'highwinrate'. If a client omits mode entirely the response won't be balanced. Consider `mode: str = 'balanced'` as the neutral default.
In ForwardTest.jsx, `res.timeframe` is referenced in the 'Periodo testato' line (line 174) but the backend response uses key 'timeframe' — verified present in response (echoed from request). OK.

avg_loss can be 0 in nosl mode (no closed losses) → profit_factor is computed as `gross_win` (2146.67 observed) which is technically not a factor. Fine for demo, but a comment/label like 'PF (nessuna perdita chiusa)' would be more honest.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest at /app/backend/tests/test_forwardtest.py runs all 3 modes + annual period + trade-date verification. Must export REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL when running pytest locally (no default). Expected observed numbers on 500-bar M15 EUR/USD real data at test-time: balanced wr~29%, hwr wr~94%, nosl closed-wr=100% + true_equity often < 10000 with a stuck open trade. Frontend testid selectors work: forward-test-panel, forwardtest-period-{Settimana|Mese|Trimestre|Anno}, forwardtest-mode-{highwinrate|balanced|nosl}, forwardtest-run-button, forwardtest-equity-chart, forwardtest-trades-table, forwardtest-winrate, forwardtest-playpause-button, forwardtest-speed-{1|3|6}, forwardtest-skip-button, forwardtest-source-badge.
rca of the issue: N/A - no functional bugs. All review-request assertions satisfied (modes work, nosl exposes floating risk honestly via true_equity/open_floating/worst_floating, trades carry entry/exit dates, annual period returns ~365 D1 candles with period_start/period_end, invalid symbol -> 404, source badge dynamic, reality-check UI renders with Equity REALE / Flottante Aperto / Peggior Flottante tiles + red SENZA STOP LOSS warning, APERTO badge appears on open trades, honesty note in Alto Winrate mode).
